entries.title: Psalms 24:1
segments: A Psalm of David. The earth [is] the LORD's, and the fullness of it; the world, and those who dwell in it.

entries.title: Psalms 24:2
segments: For He has founded it on the seas, and established it on the rivers.

entries.title: Psalms 24:3
segments: Who shall go up into the hill of the LORD? Or who shall stand in His holy place?

entries.title: Psalms 24:4
segments: He who has clean hands and a pure heart; who has not lifted up his soul to vanity, and has not sworn deceitfully.

entries.title: Psalms 24:5
segments: He shall receive the blessing from the LORD, and righteousness from the God of his salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 24:6
segments: This [is] the generation of those who seek Him, who seek Your face, [O God] of Jacob. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 24:7
segments: Lift up your heads, O gates; and be lifted up, O everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.

entries.title: Psalms 24:8
segments: Who [is] this King of glory? The LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle.

entries.title: Psalms 24:9
segments: Lift up your heads, O gates; even lift up, O everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.

entries.title: Psalms 24:10
segments: Who [is] this King of glory? The LORD of hosts, He [is] the King of glory. Selah.
